messages:
sasha: Quick sync: GA went out, we need a concise post-launch plan. My thought: one tight 48h microcycle focused on clear owners and rollback gates. Keep bugs vs enhancements strict.
omar: Agree. Propose rule: any change touching runtime or kernels -> separate canary. UI/copy + non-schema bug -> same wave.
sasha: Good rule. Jin, which customer asks should we consider as enhancements for this wave?
jin: Two asks: (1) onboarding hint for low-usage orgs, (2) smaller default batch size for embedding jobs. Both are low-risk.
nina: We should prioritize the crash fix first (from monitor alert). If crash is >12h, ship the onboarding hint as a "hotfix-help" to reduce support load.
jin: Crash repro and minimal fix PR coming, estimate 10-14h with a runtime owner review. I'll mark it `patch/urgent`.
omar: Release plan proposal: canary/crash-4967001234 -> 6h watch. If green -> promote and include `enh/mini-onboarding` + `tweak/embedding-batch` in promote-2 24h later.
release-bot: Created release plan: canary/4967001234-crash -> promote/4967001234-1 -> promote/4967001234-2. Manual approvals required: sasha + omar.
sasha: Acceptance criteria for crash: repro test in CI, error rate <0.5% on long prompt smoke, p99 within baseline +150ms. For embedding tweak: no perf regression on batch throughput.
jin: I'll add a short smoke script and a tiny dashboard tile. Pasting snippet: `./smoke_long_prompt.sh --seeds 5`
nina: On comms: only send customer note if >50 affected or billing deltas appear. We can prepare a templated note.
omar: Backlog tags we'll use: `patch/micro-4967001234`, `enh/4967001234`. Please keep all PRs small and link to the ticket.
sasha: Lock freeze at 09:00 PT tomorrow. Quick Huddle 08:45 to confirm signoffs. Thanks everyone. :sparkles:
